revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.description: Consolidated revenue, excluding assessed taxes. Goods-only and service-only concepts are not substituted for total revenue.

operating_margin.label: Operating margin
operating_margin.description: Python: operating income / revenue for the exact same annual dates; displayed as a percentage. Undefined if revenue is zero.

net_income.label: Net income
net_income.description: Net income (loss) attributable to the parent. ProfitLoss is not substituted because its noncontrolling-interest scope differs.

diluted_eps.label: Diluted EPS
diluted_eps.description: Reported diluted earnings per share; not recalculated or substituted with basic EPS.

operating_cash_flow.label: Operating cash flow
operating_cash_flow.description: Reported net cash from operating activities, including any discontinued operations.

capital_expenditure.label: Capital expenditure
capital_expenditure.description: Cash payments to acquire property, plant and equipment, shown as a positive cash outflow. Excludes acquisitions, finance lease additions and non-cash capex.

free_cash_flow.label: Free cash flow
free_cash_flow.description: Python: operating cash flow − cash payments for PP&E. Analyst-defined, non-GAAP measure; excludes finance lease principal repayments.

cash_and_equivalents.label: Cash and cash equivalents
cash_and_equivalents.description: Cash and cash equivalents at fiscal year end. Excludes short-term investments, marketable securities and restricted cash.

total_debt.label: Total debt
total_debt.description: Interest-bearing borrowings at carrying value; excludes leases. Current/noncurrent long-term debt plus short-term borrowings. LongTermDebt is the total current + noncurrent long-term-debt alternative, never added to its components. DebtCurrent is not used because its scope can include leases. No missing component is assumed zero. CommercialPaper represents the separate short-term-debt line only for the verified MSFT/AAPL profiles.

net_debt.label: Net debt
net_debt.description: Python: total debt − cash and cash equivalents. Negative values mean net cash under this definition. Short-term investments and lease liabilities are excluded.

tensions.title: Revenue and operating income increased materially
tensions.explanation: Reported revenue and operating income grew; assess the margin comparison alongside cash investment before inferring durable profitability.
comparability_warnings: Matching annual periods and concept sets do not prove unchanged economic scope; acquisitions and restatements require review.
Annual rates are not normalised for differing fiscal-year day counts.

tensions.title: Revenue growth with operating-margin contraction
tensions.explanation: Revenue rose while operating margin declined materially; investigate mix, pricing and cost changes without assuming a cause.
comparability_warnings: Matching annual periods and concept sets do not prove unchanged economic scope; acquisitions and restatements require review.
Annual rates are not normalised for differing fiscal-year day counts.

limitations: Calculated metrics use annual reported figures and may include later-filed restatements; this is not point-in-time data.
Cash capex is total company cash purchases of PP&E; it is not an AI-specific or lease-inclusive investment measure.
Free cash flow is OCF less cash PP&E purchases, an analyst-defined measure excluding finance-lease principal repayments.
Net debt excludes leases and short-term investments; debt/OCF uses year-end debt and annual OCF, not EBITDA or average debt.
No ROIC, incremental AI ROIC or valuation is calculated: attributable returns, invested capital and valuation inputs are absent.
Positive-base growth excludes negative current values; absolute changes remain available where comparable. Missing values are never zero-filled.
Matching concept sets are a minimum comparability check, not proof of unchanged economic scope; acquisitions and accounting changes require analyst review.
Tensions are numerical screening observations, not causal conclusions or investment recommendations.
